source_law.title: Stopping, standing or parking in zone for loading passengers at curb
source_law.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle for any purpose or period of time except for the expeditious loading or unloading of passengers in any place marked as a passenger curb loading zone during hours when the regulations applicable to such passenger curb loading zone are effective.

legal_analysis_note: Exact statute retained. Witnesses and recovered summaries are unreviewed where marked. Conditions, alternatives and exceptions in source_topic_inventory require separate physical scoping before delivery selection.
physical_prerequisites: Use an actual marked passenger curb loading zone with effective civil hours, stationary episode, door/occupant events and expeditious passenger transfer.
legal_interpretation_limit: A stopped vehicle alone cannot establish loading; the statutory exception is purpose and duration dependent.
